narrative: On the part. A short part. The Shrew's plot is on the post beyond it. His name is beside an old man of the house. It is not beside the lover. No flour in the hair. On the part. He is on. The strip is in the hand that is not gesturing.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Went on with the old man's strip.

entities.name: The Shrew
entities.context: Shown on part in An old man of the house
